entries.reopens_if: a stated reading fixes the base key / sequence start for (b), or the printed LP1 line layout is recovered and per-line sums differ from the text lines used here.

entries.hypothesis: 'Its words are the map, their meaning is the road, their numbers are the direction': LP1's word list is a codebook; each unsolved word reaches an entry by position k / rune offset / length; the entry's Gematria value (mod 29 or 28) is the signed advance applied at each cleartext word boundary (per-word shift A1, cumulative shift A2, or key-pointer advance through the LP1 rune stream A3).
entries.control_detail: 24/24 planted cells (rho x M x {A1,A2,A3-ks1,A3-ks2}; independent encipherer; EN_MODERN held-out L=240 on page-0 word structure; random start s and sign): min L=120 pmax 16.1 (bar 9.0-9.2), recovery240 >= 0.988. A1/A2 are beam-free exact inversions (recovery trivial, power shown by pmax).
entries.coverage: rho{position, rune offset, word length} x M{29,28} x start s 0..28 x sigma +-1 x modes {A1,A2,A3 rel1,rel2} x page heads {0,1,2} (k restarts per page) = 4,176 decodes (2,088 direct, 1,044 ks1, 1,044 ks2); keyskip1 N=1044 best 4.484 (rho1|M29|A3, HEBREW) vs bar_v3 6.632 actual-N / 9.235 N=1e6 (bar12 6.606 / 9.102); keyskip2 N=1044 best 4.660 (rho2|M28|A3, EN_KJV) vs bar_v3 6.529 actual-N / 9.034 N=1e6 (bar12 6.546 / 8.999); direct N=2088 best 5.085 (rho3|M29|A2, CY) vs bar_v3 6.895 actual-N / 9.235 N=1e6 (bar12 6.858 / 9.102). The literal composition (rho1 x A3, M29, s=0) best 3.035. 0 clear, 0 flagged, 0 near-miss.
entries.result: negative (bounded); best 5.085 (direct A2) vs keyskip1 bar 6.90 at actual N.

three_conditionals.transition_model: A1/A2 direct (no key stream, no skip relation); A3 under keyskip1/keyskip2 beam_v3 panel_max with K' indexed by cipher position; the rule itself is a new relation and was planted

entries.not_covered: semantic (dictionary-meaning) indexing of ciphertext words; pointer from word gematria; alternative codebooks (LP1 sentences/lines, other books); rule applied across page boundaries with k not restarting beyond page-0 head; atbash; start index beyond 28; M other than 29/28; detail of how a real author would handle interrupters inside words; composition orders other than road-then-direction; pages > 2 as heads; free relation.
entries.reopens_if: a reading of 'meaning' that yields a determinate per-word index (not position/length) is stated; or the LP1 codebook order is shown to differ from document order.
